_provenance.derived_from: values.dat: GPU pairs followed by their recorded WebGL1/WebGL2 context records
_provenance.transform: webgl.py's _context_config: parameters keyed by recorded id, shaderPrecisionFormats keyed 'shaderType,precisionType'
_provenance.os_attribution: renderer string (Direct3D -> win, Apple -> mac, Mesa/OpenGL -> linux)
_provenance.licence: records redistributed from the fpgen model; see UPSTREAM.md
_provenance.pruned_to: families exactly matching pools.rs GPUs (normalized family equality)
_provenance.keying: keys are "<os>/<family_of(pool renderer)>", the same normalization Rust applies
